branch: Real PyGMTSAR PSI using unwrap1d, sparse point export
notes: This follows the PyGMTSAR/InSAR.dev PSI example pattern: single-look interferograms, unwrap1d, los_displacement_mm, lstsq, velocity.
The computation is full-grid internally, as in the Golden Valley example.
Only PS-selected points are exported as user-facing outputs.
QGIS should use ps_points.gpkg or ps_points.geojson when geocoding succeeds.
Time series can be joined by ps_id.
LOS displacement sign convention follows sbas.los_displacement_mm().
